statement: Whenever transform_array(nums) returns a result r, the following all hold: (1) len(r) = len(nums); (2) for every j with 0 <= j < len(r), r[j] is either 0 or 1; (3) r is non-decreasing, i.e. r[j] <= r[j+1] for every j with 0 <= j < len(r)-1; and (4) the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(r) and r[j] = 0 equals the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that nums[i] is even, while the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(r) and r[j] = 1 equals the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that nums[i] is odd. Here nums[i] is even if nums[i] = 2k for some integer k, and odd if nums[i] = 2k+1 for some integer k.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: transform_array(nums) returns a result r; in particular, it does not fail, panic, or overflow for any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.
